ideas.pitch: An ultra-low-latency, post-training quantized keyword spotting model optimized for ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers to handle continuous on-device audio commands.
ideas.problem_statement: Edge AI Challenge: Develop, train, validate, and optimize a lightweight machine-learning model for embedded deployment under strict memory and latency constraints.
ideas.title: Quantized MobileNetV2 Audio Keyword Spotter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly maximizes the scoring rubric by heavily targeting the 45 points for model performance and 20 points for inference latency through aggressive INT8 quantization.

ideas.pitch: A compressed convolutional model running on microcontrollers to classify hand gestures in real-time from raw accelerometer and gyroscope data.
ideas.problem_statement: Edge AI Challenge: Develop, train, validate, and optimize a lightweight machine-learning model for embedded deployment under strict memory and latency constraints.
ideas.title: TinyML Gesture Recognition via MobileNet-Accelerated IMU
ideas.why_it_could_win: Keeps the model footprint exceptionally small (under 25KB RAM usage), securing maximum points in the Model Size / Resource Usage category while ensuring fast execution times.
